python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import pathlib
ROOT = pathlib.Path('/Users/guillaumeloulier/PhpstormProjects/oss/elephc/.claude/worktrees/streams-csv-signature')

p = ROOT / 'src/codegen_support/runtime/data/user.rs'
t = p.read_text()
t = t.replace('    emit_trace_exactness_flag(&mut out, functions, classes);',
              '    emit_trace_exactness_flag(&mut out, has_user_frames);', 1)
t = t.replace('''    emit_eval_reflection_metadata: bool,
    source_path: Option<&str>,
    target: Target,
) -> String {''',
              '''    emit_eval_reflection_metadata: bool,
    source_path: Option<&str>,
    has_user_frames: bool,
    target: Target,
) -> String {''', 1)
p.write_text(t)

p = ROOT / 'src/codegen/mod.rs'
t = p.read_text()
old = '''        module.source_path.as_deref(),
        module.target,
    );'''
new = '''        module.source_path.as_deref(),
        // Whether anything in this module could stand between `{main}` and a raising builtin.
        // Only the EIR bodies answer it: the checker's maps carry the built-in Throwable
        // hierarchy and a synthetic entry even for a program that declares nothing — measured,
        // they report `functions=1 classes=11` for `throw new RuntimeException("boom");`.
        !module.class_methods.is_empty()
            || !module.closures.is_empty()
            || module.functions.len() > 1,
        module.target,
    );'''
assert t.count(old) == 1, f'codegen/mod.rs: {t.count(old)} matches'
p.write_text(t.replace(old, new, 1))
print('flag wired to the EIR module')
